in_hebrew.name: בניהו
in_hebrew.meaning: בן יהו בנו של יהוה משרתו של יהוה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: בניהו הוא שם עברי המורכב משתי מילים: בן ויהו. בן משמעותו בנו של, ויהו הוא צורה מקוצרת של יהוה, שם אלוהים בעברית. משמעות השם בניהו היא בנו של יהוה או משרתו של יהוה. השם בניהו מופיע במקרא כבן של יהוידע, כהן גדול בירושלים, וכנושא משרות שונות בחצר המלכות.

in_greek.name: Βενιαμ
in_greek.long_meaning: Βενιαμ (Βeniah) προέρχεται ἀπό τὴν εβραϊκὴ λέξη בְּנִיָּהוּ (Benyahu), ἡ ὁποία σημαίνει υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ ἢ δουλος τοῦ Θεοῦ. Ὁ ὄνομα Βενιαμ ἦταν συνηθέστερο στὴν ἀρχαία Ἑλλάδα καὶ τὴ Ρώμη ὡς ὄνομα προσώπου, συμβολίζοντας τὴ σχέση τοῦ ἰδιοκτήτη του μὲ τὸν Θεό.

in_latin.name: Beniah
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Beniah originem habet in lingua hebraea, compositum ex duobus verbis: ben, quod significat filius, et Yah, quod est abbreviatio nominis Dei, Iehova. Significatio nominis Beniah est filius Dei vel servus Domini. Nomen hoc inveniuntur in Scriptura Sacra ut nomen viri, qui fuit filius Iojadae, summi sacerdotis Ierusalem.

in_english.name: Beniah
in_english.meaning: Son of God, servant of the Lord
in_english.long_meaning: The name Beniah originates from the Hebrew language, derived from two words: 'ben,' meaning son, and 'Yah,' a shortened form of Yahweh, the God of Israel. The name Beniah signifies 'son of God' or 'servant of the Lord.' It appears in the Bible as the name of a man, Beniah, son of Jehoiada, a high priest in Jerusalem, known for his bravery and loyalty. The name symbolizes a strong spiritual connection and devotion to God.

biblical_reference.note: Beniah, son of Jehoiada, was a mighty warrior and one of King Solomon's officials.

data.cultural_impact: The name Beniah holds cultural significance as it directly relates to its historical usage in the Bible where Beniah is portrayed as a brave and mighty warrior. This name has since been carried through history, inspiring generations with its association with courage, honor, and loyalty.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Beniah can be drawn from the fact that Beniah was a servant of King David, willingly carrying out his master's bidding to kill King Saul. This demonstrates Beniah's unwavering commitment to the will of God, even in the face of difficult circumstances. The name Beniah, therefore, symbolizes one who is steadfast in their faith, loyal to their master (God), and willing to do God's will, regardless of the personal cost. In essence, Beniah represents the epitome of spiritual dedication and unwavering obedience.
